description: Start a durable coding run in the remote workspace. Can spend tokens and edit files. External runs are limited to audited coding, reads and reviews; hosted shell, browser, outbound connectors, Oracle and crew/workflow/approval actions require the browser Studio surface. Use planned=true for analysis only. Dedicated Git push and draft PR tools need studio:publish; ready/merge require confirmation in Code Studio.
